_comment: Default model parameters (RESEARCH.md v2 §6.6, §6.20). Every value here is a modelling ASSUMPTION chosen for plausibility, not an estimate from real hospital data. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Units: hours unless stated.
_episode: 35-day warm-up from an empty start: Welch's method with a 1-week window suggested 29 days at the calibrated load, rounded up to whole weeks (docs/stage2_validation_report.md, docs/stage4_baselines_report.md). Then 14 measured days.
_arrivals: Arrivals are patients who will need an inpatient bed (ED patients discharged home are not modelled). Base rates are mean rates per hour; profiles are relative and normalised to mean 1 on load.
_calibration: Base rates set so that scenario A has analytical offered load 0.93 on the general wards (neurotwin.experiments.load; RESEARCH.md §6.22). Policy-independent.
_patients: Priority 1 = most urgent. Probabilities are listed for priorities 1..5.
_capacity: Staffed capacity = min(physical beds, nurses on shift x patients per nurse).
_weights: Reward/MIP priority weights omega for priorities 1..5 (RESEARCH.md §6.10).
